method: Visual inspection of the exact Three.js geometry exported to Blender/Cycles CPU;128 maximum adaptive samples, no denoiser. Lighting differs from browser hemisphere lighting.
observations: Exterior and narrow streets remain coherent with the registered footprints.
Ground-floor pointed arches, timber, openings and floor transitions are legible.
Upper rooms retain their closed ceiling and unobstructed connections.
Section removes roof and intermediate floor without floating upper exhibits or removing the neighbouring buildings.
limitation: The available browser disables WebGL; the actual notebook, floor plan and navigation were checked in the supported 2D mode.
